- Bearish material watches: [PINS](PINS.md), [EIX](EIX.md), [TAP](TAP.md), [AON](AON.md), and [TTWO](TTWO.md); none has a submitted order.
- Current researched watches: [QCOM](QCOM.md) only on a validated $170-$172.50 pullback; [FIGR](FIGR.md) only after a confirmed break below $38.60; [TTAN](TTAN.md) only after a close above $60, relief rally into $64-$67, or confirmed break below $54.20.
- PCG is CLOSED after the 2026-09-01 full exit.
- Material option watches: [SNOW](SNOW.md) requires $337-$345 stabilization or a $370 reclaim; [SPY](SPY.md) requires a break above $773.50 or below $767.
- GAP exit, MU and RBLX target trims, and NVDA re-entry all reconciled as filled. SMMT has active GTC protection and NVDA has active bracket protection. INTC expired unfilled. Both MSTR spreads are closed, with approximately $801 combined gross realized profit before fees.
